headline: Japanese yen jumps as top currency diplomat Mimura reiterates strong currency alliance with the US
summary: The yen jumped after top currency diplomat Mimura reiterated a strong-currency alliance with the US. Japan remains concerned about yen weakness and is monitoring the impact of US-Japan rate differences.
why: The yen is a major global currency, and Japanese authorities intervene in markets when it weakens sharply. Rate gaps between Japan and the US drive yen moves.

impacts.name: Japanese yen
impacts.why: The article reports the yen jumping after Japan's currency diplomat reiterated the US alliance.
